headlines.title: Singapore-based investors now the top non-local buyers of Hong Kong office assets
headlines.summary:
Singapore-based investors have become the largest group of non-local buyers of commercial properties in Hong Kong, drawn by the sizeable correction in the prices of distressed assets amid a slump in the city’s office segment, according to Colliers.
The demand from Singapore was likely to remain steady in the coming months, given that the prices of office assets have declined by as much as 50 per cent, according to Thomas Chak, head of capital markets and investment services at the property...

headlines.summary_zh: 高力国际数据显示，新加坡投资者已成为香港商业地产的最大非本地买家群体，受惠于香港写字楼市场低迷期间不良资产价格大幅回调的吸引。鉴于写字楼资产价格仍处低位，未来数月新加坡资金需求预计将保持稳定。

headlines.title: 深圳金融监管局：辖内银行已审批“白名单”项目443个，放款4365亿元
headlines.summary: 深圳金融监管局党委委员、一级巡视员陈飞鸿在该局2026年上半年新闻发布会上透露，该局持续发挥房地产融资协调机制作用，截至6月末，辖内银行累计审批“白名单”项目443个、发放贷款4365.24亿元。同时，该局积极与住建等部门联动，协同推进城市更新重点项目攻坚。（证券时报）

headlines.title: 创业板指探底回升涨1.55%，大消费板块集体走强
headlines.summary: 1，整体走势：市场全天探底回升，三大指数集体反弹。个股涨多跌少，沪深京三市超4200股飘红，今日成交2.31万亿。截止收盘沪指涨0.4%，深成指涨1.1%，创业板指涨1.55%。 2，行业板块：食品、乳业、零售、游戏等板块涨幅居前，光刻机、存储芯片、先进封装、玻璃基板等板块跌幅居前。 3，热门概念：食品、乳业、零售等消费股集体走强，欢乐家、李子园、东百集团等多股涨停。游戏股震荡拉升，电魂网络、恺英网络、巨人网络涨停。汽车整车板块反弹，北汽蓝谷涨停。券商等金融股午后走高，华林证券涨停。下跌方面，光刻机概念股调整，茂莱光学、新莱应材跌超10%。

headlines.title: 瑞银CEO认为未来市场将继续出现波动性“飙升”
headlines.summary: 瑞银集团首席执行官Sergio Ermotti在接受采访时表示，他预计今年剩余时间里“波动性飙升”还将继续。“从宏观形势、地缘政治局势、当前的争论，以及我们在股市中看到的巨大分化来看，能源价格面临的压力可能会给通胀带来潜在的逆风”。Ermotti表示投资者不会喜欢这种波动，“我确实预计在今年剩余时间里波动性将继续飙升”。

headlines.title_en: Tianqi Lithium increased its registered capital to approximately 1.706 billion yuan
headlines.summary_en: Tianyancha App shows that on July 28, Tianqi Lithium Corporation underwent an industrial and commercial change, increasing its registered capital from approximately 1.641 billion yuan to about 1.706 billion yuan. The company, founded in October 1995, has legal representative Jiang Anqi, and its business scope includes export of self-produced battery-grade lithium carbonate, industrial-grade lithium carbonate, and related lithium series products. It is jointly held by Zhang Jing, Chengdu Tianqi Industry (Group) Co., Ltd., and others.

headlines.title: 国家烟草专卖局约谈爱奇迹（深圳）技术有限公司
headlines.summary: 针对日常监管中发现的爱奇迹（深圳）技术有限公司涉嫌违法违规生产经营、合规管理薄弱等突出问题，近日，国家烟草专卖局依法对爱奇迹（深圳）技术有限公司负责人进行了行政约谈，要求其严格遵守《中华人民共和国烟草专卖法》、《中华人民共和国烟草专卖法实施条例》及《电子烟管理办法》等规定和国家限制类产业政策，切实履行合规经营主体责任，严格落实电子烟监管要求，建立健全内部合规管理体系，全面提升企业管理水平。（烟草微报微信公号）

headlines.title_en: State Tobacco Monopoly Administration meets with Aiqiji (Shenzhen) Technology Co., Ltd.
headlines.summary_en: In response to prominent issues found in daily supervision, including suspected illegal production and operation and weak compliance management by Aiqi (Shenzhen) Technology Co., Ltd., the State Tobacco Monopoly Administration recently held an administrative interview with the company's leadership. It required strict adherence to the Tobacco Monopoly Law, its implementation regulations, the E-Cigarette Management Measures, and national restricted industry policies, urging the company to fulfill its compliance management responsibilities, strictly implement e-cigarette regulatory requirements, establish a robust internal compliance management system, and comprehensively improve management levels. (Tobacco News WeChat public account)
